description: This file contains unit tests for the QUIC crypto server, specifically testing the behavior of the crypto server during handshake processes, including handling of client hello messages, certificate validation, and configuration correctness.

classes.name: DummyProofVerifierCallback
classes.description: A dummy implementation of ProofVerifierCallback that asserts false if Run is called.

classes.name: CryptoServerTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the QUIC crypto server handshake logic, supporting multiple parameterized versions.

methods.name: GetTestParams
methods.description: Constructs a list of test parameters with decreasing supported versions.

methods.name: PrintToString
methods.description: Converts TestParams to a string for test naming.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including server config and client hello message.

methods.name: CheckServerHello
methods.description: Validates the server hello message contains expected version labels and client address.

methods.name: ShouldSucceed
methods.description: Validates that a client hello message is accepted by the server.

methods.name: ShouldFailMentioning
methods.description: Validates that a client hello message is rejected with a specific error substring.

methods.name: ProcessValidationResult
methods.description: Processes the result of client hello validation and checks for expected success or failure.

methods.name: GenerateNonce
methods.description: Generates a nonce string based on current time and orbit data.

methods.name: CheckRejectReasons
methods.description: Checks that the rejection reasons in the handshake match expected reasons.

methods.name: CheckRejectTag
methods.description: Asserts that the handshake output is a rejection.

methods.name: XlctHexString
methods.description: Returns a hex string representing a test leaf certificate hash.
